user.title: Set up Sanmli TH-05 candles
user.description: Choose the infrared emitter that can reach the candles. A receiver is optional and lets Home Assistant react when the physical remote is used.

data_description.infrared_entity_id: The blaster that sends commands to the candles.
data_description.infrared_receiver_entity_id: Optional. Lets automations trigger on presses of the handheld remote.
data_description.send_count: How many times each command transmits. These candles sample their receiver on a duty cycle, so a single frame is sometimes missed and a press appears to do nothing. Three is what the bench set needed. Raise it if presses still get dropped, lower it if one is enough.

init.title: Sanmli TH-05 candles
init.description: How many times should each command transmit? Raise this if button presses are sometimes ignored.

data_description.send_count: A press on the handheld remote sends the same code several times. Matching that makes presses land reliably.
